They’re adjusting their strategies, but nothing can break through us!|audio = Moltenwave-26.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 26 (Formerly, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Boomer''' is an [[Enemies|enemy]] that explodes upon its death, which debuffs [[towers]] caught in the bile bubble. It has average health but slightly fast speed. The '''Boomer''' appears in [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode. When the original [[Polluted Wasteland]] was in the game, the '''Boomer''' did not spawn in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes and was instead replaced by the [[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]]. ==Appearance== The '''Boomer''' is a large humanoid with a waist in its rig. It has a green skin color and a crimson-brown torso, waist and legs. It has a bloated chest and stomach with tumors, which has a dark green explosive device strapped on it. The explosive has an orange caution symbol, red and blue wires and an antenna with a flashing red light on it. ==Strategy== *The '''Boomer''' is quite fast, allowing it to quickly get to your towers and debuff them. **Additionally, it often times spawns alongside other, at times faster or aggro enemies, which distract the towers from the '''Boomer''' and allowing it to get closer to your towers. *Killing the '''Boomer''' before it gets within range of your towers is the most ideal way to deal with '''Boomers'''. Keep in mind that it has quite a long debuff time. **Placing your towers away from the path is a good way to avoid the '''Boomer's''' debuff. **Long-range towers, such as the [[Hunter]] are the best at keeping a distance away from the '''Boomer'''. **The [[Engineer]]'s sentries can also be useful, as the sentries cannot be debuffed. *The [[DJ Booth]] allows towers to shoot the '''Boomer''' from further away, potentially defeating it before it blows up near your towers. It can also increase the damage of towers, allowing them to defeat it more quickly. **It and the [[Commander]] can also partially negate the '''Boomer's''' debuffs. **The [[Mercenary Base]] can also further contribute to the speedrun demise of the '''Boomer''' with its damage buff. *While the [[Medic]] is not able to shield towers from the [[Fatigue Debuff]] or [[Range Debuff]], the shield on towers is not broken by them, meaning its [[Firerate Buff]] can be used to partially mitigate the '''Boomer's''' debuffs. **Towers which are normally immune to stuns by default are not immune to the debuffs either. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} BoomerStunAnimation.gif|Current stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Boomer.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseBoomer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.2.0GenericThumbnail3.png|'''Boomer''' on the game thumbnail {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tesla Tower Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Boomer''' on a promotional video.
